question: If the cost of painting the entire surface area of ​​a cubic structure at the rate of 23 paise per cm² is ₹1,006.02, find the volume (in cm³) of the cubic structure.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost = ₹1006.02, Rate = ₹0.23/cm²

Area = 1006.02 ÷ 0.23 = 4374 cm²

6a² = 4374 ⇒ a² = 729 ⇒ a = 27

Volume = a³ = 27³ = 19683

**∴ Answer = 19683**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Painting cost = ₹1006.02

Rate = 23 paise/cm² = ₹0.23/cm²

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cube = 6a²

Cost = Area × Rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area = Cost ÷ Rate

⇒ = 1006.02 ÷ 0.23

⇒ = 4374 cm²

⇒ 6a² = 4374

⇒ a² = 4374 ÷ 6 = 729

⇒ a = √729 = 27 cm

⇒ Volume = a³

⇒ = 27³

⇒ = 19683 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 19683.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube Surface Area

6a² where a = side

Unit Conversion

23 paise = ₹0.23

Volume Formula

a³ for cube
